title: Research sprint goal: Benchmark run: measure the changes since the records of 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09 across the knowledge scenarios
goal: The pinned models' list prices the benchmark harness uses (Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 in kb/public/claude/models.csv and the open Sonnet 5.5 cache-read conflict in kb/public/_conflicts.md) are checked against the live pricing page and written as kb facts where they changed; the Claude Code releases since 2.1.293 are checked for changes to the result event's usage, modelUsage and total_cost_usd fields and to the effort levels' defaults, and written as kb facts, so the record prices and labels its runs as billed. An unchanged price or field is recorded as a dated confirmation, not left unstated.
